intro: Good morning, Queen Emma! Your kingdom has sent you letters.
letter-first: Look! Tilly the dove has a letter for you. Swipe it open!
letter-next: Tilly has another letter for you. Open it!
letter1-intro: A letter from the pig! Tap the words and read them.
letter2-intro: A letter from the fox! Tap the words and read them.
letter3-intro: A letter from the hen! Tap the words and read them.
letter1-full-mud: Can the pig go in the mud?
letter1-full-pond: Can the pig go in the pond?
letter1-help: Can the pig go in the... where? Read the last word.
letter2-full: Send six apples to the fox.
letter3-full-hat: The hen is sad. I want a red hat.
letter3-full-cap: The hen is sad. I want a red cap.
letter3-full-sock: The hen is sad. I want a red sock.
letter3-help: The hen is sad. I want a... what? Read the last two words.
hint-read: Tap a word. Then slide your finger along the dots.
hint-bell: Stuck? When the bell is full, ring it for help.
letter1-act: Now help the pig. Drag the pig on the map.
hint-reread-last: Read the last word again. Where does the pig want to go?
pig-happy-mud: Oink oink! I love the mud!
pig-happy-pond: Splish splash! I love the pond!
hint-store: Tap the storehouse to open it.
hint-apples: Drag the apples into your basket.
hint-send: When your basket is ready, drag it onto the map.
hint-number: Look at the number in the letter.
hint-who: Who is the letter for? Read it again.
fox-have-1: I have one. I want six!
fox-have-2: I have two. I want six!
fox-have-3: I have three. I want six!
fox-have-4: I have four. I want six!
fox-have-5: I have five. I want six!
send-again: Now there are six. Send the basket again!
fox-six: Six apples! Thank you, Queen Emma!
hint-wardrobe: Tap the little hut to open the wardrobe.
hint-dress: What does the hen want? Drag it to the hen.
hen-wrong-redhat: Hee hee! A red hat? No, thank you!
hen-wrong-redcap: Hee hee! A red cap? No, thank you!
hen-wrong-redsock: Hee hee! A red sock? No, thank you!
hen-wrong-bluehat: Hee hee! A blue hat? No, thank you!
hen-wrong-bluecap: Hee hee! A blue cap? No, thank you!
hen-wrong-bluesock: Hee hee! A blue sock? No, thank you!
hint-reread-two: Read the last two words again.
hen-happy-hat: Cluck cluck! I love my red hat!
hen-happy-cap: Cluck cluck! I love my red cap!
hen-happy-sock: Cluck cluck! A red sock on my head! I love it!
cheer: Hooray! A unicorn has come to the farm!
jewel: A new jewel for your crown!
finale: Well done, Queen Emma! The farm is happy.
